name: shop
lead: Sells this experience's products for Gems. Minefort asks the player in its own dialog; the pack learns only paid or not, never a balance, price or reason. Calls yield. Without the platform's shop every answer is no.

functions.name: prompt
functions.signature: shop.prompt(player: Player | string, product: string) → string ?
functions.description: Asks Minefort to offer `product` to the player. Returns the request id, or nil when it was not offered.

functions.name: owns
functions.signature: shop.owns(player: Player | string, product: string) → boolean
functions.description: Whether the player owns this pass.

functions.name: on_paid
functions.description: Called once per paid purchase; returning without an error hands it over. An error leaves it waiting, to be called again later.

functions.name: on_declined
functions.description: Called when the player said no or did not answer.
